relations.subject: James (Jim) Douglas Pearson
relations.evidence: employed from the age of 16 as bookfetcher in the University Library there.

relations.subject: James (Jim) Douglas Pearson
relations.evidence: won a scholarship for Hebrew at St. John’s College.

relations.subject: James (Jim) Douglas Pearson
relations.evidence: Then studied Arabic and Persian at Pembroke College, graduated 1936.

relations.subject: James (Jim) Douglas Pearson
relations.evidence: In 1936-41 again worked in Cambridge University Library

relations.subject: James (Jim) Douglas Pearson
relations.evidence: after war service, 1945-50, as assistant Under-Librarian.

relations.subject: James (Jim) Douglas Pearson
relations.role: Senior Fellow and Professor of Bibliography
relations.evidence: then 1972-77 Senior Fellow and Professor of Bibliography there.
